source_document: 03-2关于航天长征化学工程股份有限公司收购航天氢能有限公司股权的可行性研究报告（公开）.docx
observations: The risk table preserved all four disclosed risks instead of collapsing to one row.
The financial group extracted calendar-year forecasts, but mapping 2025 to t0 remains subject to the unresolved t0 business definition.
The project group filled ten fields without evidence and therefore has the highest unsupported-inference risk.
The company and financial groups determined wall-clock completion time despite five-way concurrent scheduling.
One initial validation warning identified table_index as a missing legal source-anchor property; the evidence schema was corrected without rerunning the model.
